name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

parameters.content:
## Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

Runs 08:30 Asia/Taipei daily (set the workflow Timezone to Asia/Taipei in Settings).

1. Fetch jobs from 8 sources (RSS/API first, scrape fallback for sites with no public API)
2. Normalize + dedupe against Google Sheets (job_url, then company+title)
3. Hard-filter reject/keep keyword rules
4. AI Taiwan-eligibility check (Claude Haiku)
5. Async / role-fit tagging + scoring (0-100, keep >=70)
6. Log to Google Sheets (Raw / Filtered / Rejected)
7. Instant alert + cover letter draft (Claude Sonnet) for score >=85
8. Daily digest via Telegram/Gmail

See README.md in this repo for setup (credentials, Sheet structure, source URLs to verify).

### Scraping sources: Wellfound, Dynamite Jobs, YC Work at a Startup, Otta

These have no public search API and are largely JS-rendered / behind auth, so the HTTP Request + regex Normalize nodes below are best-effort and may return 0 results as-is. If that happens, swap the HTTP Request node for a headless-browser/scraping service (Firecrawl, ScrapingBee, Browserless) pointed at the same URL, keeping the output field the Normalize node expects (`data` = raw HTML string).

### Credentials to configure before activating

- Google Sheets OAuth2 (Raw Jobs / Filtered Jobs / Rejected / Applied sheets)
- Anthropic API key (Generic Header Auth credential, header `x-api-key`) — used for the Taiwan-eligibility check (Haiku) and cover letters (Sonnet)
- Telegram Bot API (chat id)
- Gmail OAuth2 (or disable the Gmail node and keep Telegram only)

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", max_tokens: 300, temperature: 0, messages: [{ role: "user", content: "You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule:
Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:
- The job says worldwide remote.
- The job says work from anywhere.
- The job says global remote.
- The job says APAC remote.
- The job allows international contractors.
- The job accepts people based anywhere.
- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only:
{"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear", "reason": "short reason", "location_risk": "low/medium/high", "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high", "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear", "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"}

Job post:
" + ($json.description || "").slice(0, 6000) }]}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({model: "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929", max_tokens: 500, temperature: 0.4, messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Use this background:
Bilingual English and Mandarin. Grew up in California and Taiwan. Digital marketing background. Data science bootcamp experience. Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI. Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads. AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor. Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics.

Make the letter specific to this job. Mention how Jerry can help the company: reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, turn messy data into business action.

Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.

Job title: " + $json.job_title + " at " + $json.company + "

Job post:
" + ($json.description || "").slice(0, 6000) }}]}) }}
